title: Q14
description:
“That through death He might destroy him who had the power of death, that is, the devil.”
Read: Gen 3:1–19, Rev 12:9, Heb 9:27
a) Death entered through the serpent's deception (Gen 3). Revelation names that serpent the devil. What does the Eden background bring to “destroy” here?
b) If men still die (9:27), what has been broken: death itself, or the devil's hold through it?
